query:
insert into parameters (key, type, version, value)
        values (?1, 'string', ?2, ?3)
        on conflict (key) do update set
            type = 'string',
            version = excluded.version,
            value = excluded.value,
            key_id = null,
            ciphertext = null,
            nonce = null,
            wrapped_dek = null,
            dek_nonce = null,
            updated_at = unixepoch()
        where parameters.version = excluded.version - 1
